name: Halo: Combat Evolved
description: The campaign's characters for OpenCE (the Halo: Combat Evolved decompilation's port): Cortana, Sergeant Johnson, Captain Keyes, the Pillar of Autumn's Marines and crew, and the Covenant, as character cards; a lorebook of the setting; and the action book of what they can do in the game.
comment: Authored content only. No chats, memories or voices are bundled; those are each player's own.
